stories.headline: Warhammer Blood Bowl delayed to early 2027 after latest playtest
stories.summary: Slitherine has moved Warhammer Blood Bowl's full release from 2026 to early 2027 following feedback from its latest playtest. The ongoing test now includes Arena mode, where teams try to complete ten matches without losing. Tomb Kings and Bretonnians will be free additions, while Blood Bowl 3 owners are promised a free upgrade that retains their purchased teams and cosmetics. No specific 2027 release date has been announced.

stories.headline: Jackbox Games says it has no plans to replace writers or artists with generative AI
stories.summary: Jackbox Games CEO Mike Bilder told PC Gamer that the studio's comedy writing and art are made by people and that it has no intention of replacing those contributions with generative AI. Bilder acknowledged potential uses for AI tools and research, but said the company does not plan to substitute AI-generated assets for its human-made creative work. The studio released The Jackbox Party Pack 12 in October.

stories.headline: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time developers discuss the Switch 2 remake
stories.summary: Nintendo's November 9 regional news update highlights its four-part developer interview about the Switch 2 remake released November 5. Eiji Aonuma explains that revisiting the 1998 adventure was partly meant to help newer Zelda developers study the series' roots, while the team reflects on how exploration, Z-targeting and carefully paced progression shaped the original. The interview series was first published in other regions on November 2.

stories.headline: World of Warcraft: Forever increases dungeon monster XP by 50%
stories.summary: Blizzard has applied a hotfix increasing experience earned from dungeon enemy kills by 50% after player feedback about the new leveling balance. Dungeon quest rewards remain an important part of progression, while repeat runs now offer more experience than before. The change was announced on November 8 and is already live.

stories.headline: EVE Online's Fractured Skies expansion arrives November 10 with faction warfare changes
stories.summary: EVE Online's Fractured Skies expansion launches November 10 with four navy attack battlecruisers, an updated HUD preview, new Military Campaigns and improvements for new players. It also prepares a recurring Conquest system for factional PvP, with the first Conquest expected in February 2027. Companion FPS EVE Vanguard begins its paid, always-available alpha on the same day, with ground operations unlocking activities in EVE Online.

stories.headline: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy confirms January 28, 2027 release date
stories.summary: Owlcat Games has confirmed that its investigation-focused Warhammer 40,000 CRPG launches January 28, 2027 on PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Players build an Inquisition warband, investigate conspiracies and fight turn-based battles in the Calixis Sector. The Founder's beta closes January 7 as the studio prepares for launch; a Switch 2 version is planned for later.

stories.headline: NieR:Automata download-size bug fixed after 366GB downloads
stories.summary: Square Enix says it has identified and resolved the issue that caused some NieR:Automata downloads on Steam to swell from roughly 50GB to 366GB after a recent update. The download requirement has returned to its normal size. Square Enix has not publicly explained the underlying cause.

stories.headline: Persona 5 Royal gets 73% off in Fanatical's November 9 flash sale
stories.summary: Fanatical's Birthday Bash PC sale has added a 24-hour flash discount of 73% on Persona 5 Royal, alongside 63% off Dave the Diver and 75% off Command: Modern Operations. These flash deals are due to end November 10 at 17:00, while the wider promotion continues through November 16. The reported discounts are on Fanatical, not Steam, and regional prices or stock may vary.
